description:
Check a Robinhood Chain transaction before it is signed. Send the transaction you are about to sign and get back `pass`, `warn` or `block` with the reasons behind it.

It covers transactions that approve, transfer or swap a token on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663), including approvals to a new spender. It flags drainer contracts, broad approvals to unknown spenders, lookalike Stock Tokens (read live from the token's own ticker and name), and a size larger than the pools can take. Zorvu does not grade the liquidity, holders or sellability of tokens that are not official Stock Tokens: such a token comes back `token_not_graded` (info), and archived readings never count as a pass. `intent.usd` checks the size against measured sell depth, and `policy` applies the caller's own ceilings.

`pass` means the transaction passed the checks listed in `checks_run` at the time shown in `checked_at`, nothing broader. It does not mean the transaction is safe, and it is not a promise about what the transaction will do. `warn` and `block` are Zorvu's measurements, not instructions and not advice; the decision stays with the caller. Every reason carries a `finding_type`; `verdict` classifies those findings, and `decision_owner` is always `caller`. Zorvu never builds, routes, signs or sends a transaction, holds no keys, and charges no fee.

Anything Zorvu could not read comes back `null` with a reason code saying so, never as a pass. `mode: "fast"` skips live chain reads; what it gives up is listed in each `not_checked_fast` reason. Requires a Zorvu API key, sent in the Authorization header of the MCP client config; the tool takes no key argument. Not financial advice.

chain_id.description: Robinhood Chain. The only chain supported.

usd.description: Intended size in USD, checked against measured sell depth.

mode.description: fast: no live chain reads, for an answer in well under a second.

receipt.description: true keeps a receipt of this answer and returns its id and url, readable later with get_receipt. Off by default; nothing is kept without it.

tx.description: The transaction you are about to sign.

name: precheck_transaction

checks_run.description: The checks that ran. pass covers only these.

data_version.description: Which version of Zorvu answered: code is the deployed git short sha (null when the deploy passed none), newest_reading_at the freshest reading behind this answer.

decision_owner.description: Who decides what happens to the transaction. Always the caller.

note.description: One line saying Zorvu reports findings and the caller decides.

age_s.description: Age of the stale reading in seconds, on an unavailable finding that has one.

finding_type.description: What kind of finding this is: observed_identifier (a known drainer address, or contract code read live), lookalike_match (a ticker or name matching an official Stock Token), calculated_threshold (a size against measured depth or a policy figure), customer_policy (your own allow list or max size), inference (resting on a heuristic or an archived reading), unavailable (the check could not run, or its data was stale).

receipt.description: Present only when the request asked for a receipt and it was kept. No receipt field means no receipt was kept.

verdict.description: Zorvu's classification of the findings: block means at least one finding Zorvu classifies as high severity, warn at least one medium, pass neither. What happens next is the caller's call.

title: Pre-sign transaction check
